description: Inspect and explain bmad-loop run artifacts under `.bmad-loop/runs/`. Use for live health checks ("is it stuck?", "is the loop alive?", "what is the agent doing?") and post-run forensics ("what happened?", "why did story X fail?", "where did the tokens go?"). Also triggers on "monitor/check/summarize the loop", "why did the run pause?", Vietnamese "theo dõi bmad loop", "phân tích run", "đọc log của run", and equivalent requests in other languages. Use only for bmad-loop's own run artifacts, not application runtime logs or CI-provider build logs.
